CROP CIRCLES OF 1990

 

Baltic Farm, Bishop Cannings, Wiltshire. Formed 3rd May.

A single circle appeared in a remote location behind Morgan's Hill. It was 23.5 metres in diameter. The crop looked like it had been just brushed over due to the immaturity of the young wheat. The formation was located quite near to several Tumuli's and bronze age earthworks. This was the first circle to appeared in the Avebury are in 1990.

Bishop Cannings, Nr Devizes, Wiltshire. Formed Early May.

An enormous ringed circle appeared on top of the Ridgeway. The circle was over 200 ft in diameter with three outer rings. A fourth ring was added a number of weeks later. Also thirty six grapeshot circles were spotted over the field and within the circle itself.

 Punchbowl, Cheesefoot Head, Nr Winchester, Hampshire. Formed 18th May.

Chilcomb Farm, Cheesefoot Head, Nr Winchester, Hampshire. Formed 23rd May.

Longwarren , Cheesefoot Head, Nr Winchester, Hampshire. Formed 30th May.

Morgans Hill, Nr Devizes, Wiltshire. Formed 28/29th May.

Stone Pitt Hill, nr Blackland, Wiltshire. Reported 2nd June. 
Hazeley Farm Fields (The Gallops), Cheesefoot Head, Nr Winchester, Hampshire. Formed 2nd June.

Exton, Nr Bishop Waltham, East Hampshire. Formed Early June.

This striking Quintuplet design was set in an idyllic location just outside of Exton. It had a clockwise swirled in the central circle (20 metres in diameter) and 6 meter diameter satellites.

Longwood Estate (2), Cheesefoot Head, Nr Winchester, Hampshire. Formed 6th June.

Bickington, Newton Abbot, South Devon. Formed 10th June.

A group of circles.

Yeo Farm, Nr Dartmoor Halfway Inn, Nr Newton Abbot, South Devon. Formed June.

A group of four Circles. Diameters 22 feet,8 feet and 13 feet.

 Longwarren, nr Chilcomb, Hampshire. Reported  20th June.
Telegraph Hill, Cheesefoot Head, Nr Winchester, Hampshire.
Lichfield (A34 road), Nr Newbury, Hampshire.  Formed 23rd June.
Twyford Down,  nr Morestead,  Hampshire. Reported  30th June.
Longwood Estate, Cheesefoot Head, Nr Winchester, Hampshire.

Upton Scudamore, nr Warminster, Wiltshire. Reported in July.

Three satellite quintuplets formed just outside the town of Westbury, renowned for circles in the 1980s. The satellites were arranged in a triangle configuration around a larger central circle. A keen crop Watcher had a missing time experience in connection with the crop circle.

Following a huge success in Japan C.P.R. International is currently in the process of producing the first comprehensive CD-ROM for UK and USA, which will include photographs from the air and ground by Colin Andrews over the past 17 years (plus some from police forces and the Ministry of Defense). The photographs will be fully referenced with maps and research comments etc... Wellington, Devon. Formed 1st July

A dumbell shape with an additional single circle. It was believe the dumbell formed approx. Monday 1st July and a four metre circle formed approx. 3rd July. In 1989 the land was visited by a crucifix (quintuplet) Formation with additional rings.

Lower Peover, Northwich, Cheshire. Reported 2nd July.

One mile from M6. A large circle 30 metres in Diameter.

Chilcomb Down, nr Chilcomb, Hampshire.  Reported 7th July. 
Alton Barnes, Nr Avebury, Wiltshire. Formed 12th July.
Crawley Down, South Wonston, Wiltshire.  Formed 13th July

Stanton St Bernard. Formed Mid July.

A claw like appendage to a single circle with accompanying grapeshot.
Formed very near to the large pictogram below Milk Hill.

Farley Mount, Nr Winchester, Hampshire.

Amport, Nr Andover, Hampshire. Formed Mid July.

"The winged Circle" contained a 15 ft circle with two protruding arms each side.

Amersham, The Chilterns, Buckinghamshire. Formed Mid July.

A six circle complex pictogram with odd shape spurs and avenues connected to the main design.
It was 60 metres in length. All the circles were flowing in a anti-clockwise direction.

Little Missenden, Buckinghamshire. Formed mid-July.

A 11 metre diameter ring formed in Linseed, a rare crop for the phenomenon.

Halton. Nr Wendover, Buckinghamshire.  Formed Mid July.

Six spur single circle, each one radiating in various directions.

Burton Hastings, Nr Coventry, Warwickshire. Formed July.

A single circle 30 feet in diameter. It was said it was impressive from the witnesses who visited the circle.
It was find by two farmers of the same land.
